text:
kai-fin: FYI international batch for GlobalCare ran at 06:10 UTC. One large EUR invoice (€42,300) attempted by corporate card and returned `AUTH_REJECT_3DS`; a second token returned `DO_NOT_HONOR`. Customer prefers wire if possible. Need plan: retries vs wire, FX handling, and any compliance flags.

omar-payments: Recommendation: pause auto-retries for these tokens immediately. Offer secure SWIFT wire via the portal and mark invoice awaiting_wire. If they wire, we'll mark paid on confirmation. If they ask to retry, only allow a single manual retry with alternate routing. Also propose a temporary hold/term while wire clears (suggest up to €50k).

billing-bot: [system] payment.failed events=2 codes=[AUTH_REJECT_3DS, DO_NOT_HONOR] event_ts=2087654321

rachel-support: Draft customer message (neutral):

Hi GlobalCare 10:10 AM UTC2 1) We attempted to process your scheduled invoice but the issuing bank declined the card attempts; no funds were captured. 2) We can pause retries and provide secure SWIFT wire instructions and an invoice link via your customer portal (wiring can take 1-3 business days). 3) If you prefer, we can attempt a single retry with alternate routing. Please reply with your preference and we will proceed.

Redwood Billing

I'll send this in ticket #7321 and ask if they want FX billed to them or to Redwood.

maya-legal: Good wording. Add: 1) Do not reference 3DS failure to the customer; say "issuing bank declined." 2) For SWIFT we must collect beneficiary name and invoice reference for reconciliation and AML screening. If wire > €25k, notify Compliance for a quick review before releasing temp credit. Do not paste account details in Slack.

diego-ops: Approving temporary hold up to €50k to avoid service disruption while wire clears; set metadata temp_hold=eur50k_net7 and ops_review=day5. I'll be the reviewer.

omar-payments: I'll pause retries and set metadata: /payments set-meta acct_globalcare temp_hold=eur50k_net7 awaiting_payment=wire; Also creating invoice link via internal command: /invoice create --acct acct_globalcare --currency EUR --expires 7d

billing-bot: [system] invoice.link created https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_gc_7321 (expires 7 days). metadata updated: temp_hold=eur50k_net7 awaiting_payment=wire ops_review=day5

rachel-support: Sent message in ticket #7321 via secure channel and asked whether they would like FX converted to USD or billed in EUR. Customer replied: "Please send SWIFT instructions in EUR, we'll initiate today." :white_check_mark:

omar-payments: Cancelling scheduled retries and marking payment tokens awaiting manual collect. Notifying Compliance due to wire >€25k.

billing-bot: [system] compliance.notify created ticket=compliance-5421 reason=wire_gt_25k account=acct_globalcare

kai-fin: Thanks team. Closing this thread 1) status: retries paused, invoice link & SWIFT instructions sent via portal, temp_hold approved, compliance notified. Will reconcile on receipt of bank confirmation. :thumbsup:
